parts.title: Task 1
parts.passage_text:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The table below gives information on consumer spending on different items in five different countries in 2002.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

parts.title: Task 2
parts.passage_text: When a country develops its technology, the traditional skills and ways of life will die out. It is pointless to try and keep them alive. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
